description: Logic that applies to many calls but is not part of any one of them: caching, metrics, retries, authentication.
The nesting of wrappers; the outermost runs first on each call and decides what the inner layers ever see.
A store, sink, token source or clock passed into a factory instead of created at module level.
Each `functools.wraps` layer sets `__wrapped__`, so `inspect.unwrap` follows the stack back to the original function.
Refreshing an expired credential once per call and retrying once, so a broken token source cannot cause a refresh storm.
